note: Contract templates (S3.4, D-113; brief §10). The format is described at the top of src/sim/contracts.js. One of each of the first three types (D-010); S3.5 writes ten. `pay` is the whole fee for every crate handed over sealed and on time; `advance` is paid when the contract is taken and comes off the fee; `latePay` is the share still paid when late (0: the contract fails the moment it is late); `followed` is the chance somebody follows it; `cargo` is the crates put in the hold (or, with a `claim`, the crates the claim can give); `value` is what a port pays for one of them if you sell the cargo instead, which fails the contract; `reputation` is what delivering it whole and on time, or failing it, does to the client's standing.

items.title: Cold freight, no questions
items.contact: A man who would not give a name
items.text: Four crates stencilled as agricultural pumps. They are not pumps. Get them past the patrol lines to the drop and do not open them.
items.note: Margo flags it: somebody has already asked about this cargo.

cargo.label: Manifest 0412 · Agricultural pumps
cargo.contents: Under a layer of pump housings, rifle parts in oiled paper. Confederation stamps on every bundle.

items.title: Cold chain to the far dock
items.text: Two coolers of tissue culture for a clinic at the drop. It spoils if it is late, so late is the same as lost.
items.note: Clean paperwork. The coolers rattle a little.

cargo.label: Courier cooler · Reach Medical
cargo.contents: Racks of culture vials in cold gel. One rack is labelled in a hand nobody at the cooperative writes in.

items.title: Claim on the Aphelion
items.contact: Lowry & Sons Recovery, for the Union
items.text: The Aphelion is a dead ore tender on the chart. Strip her and bring the salvage to the drop. The more you bring, the more you are paid.
items.note: Two other crews hold the same claim. One of them has a ship.

cargo.label: Aphelion salvage
cargo.contents: Pump stators, a pressure door off its hinges and coils of good cable, all tagged with the Union's claim number.
